column1: # Tasks for the interpretation-review study. A participant is given the GOAL in plain words (never a question to type) and phrases their own question; the prototype proposes an interpretation, they review/edit/run it and say whether the answer is what they wanted. Gold = the intended typed query (the evaluator's IR text), used only to score correctness AUTOMATICALLY next to the participant's own verdict. Category = what the task stresses. Database: data/gen_courier_ext.db (the same vehicle as the development set); the sealed acceptance questions are not used.
# columns (TAB): task, category, goal shown to the participant, gold IR
